+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.9"
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Manage ICX logging destinations, severity levels and syslog facility.

+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or global logging toggle.
+    type: str
+    choices: [on, host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424]

+    description: Host name or IPv4/IPv6 address for C(dest=host).

+    type: str

+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: host, name: '2001:db8::1', udp_port: 514}
+      - {facility: local7}
+

+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: console}
+      - {dest: buffered, level: debugging}
+    state: absent
+'''

+commands:

+  returned: always
+  type: list

+

+    return None
+
+

+

+    buffered_seen = False

+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):

+    current_facility = next((h for h in have if h.get('dest') == 'facility'), {})

+        if command not in commands:
+            commands.append(command)

+        command = 'logging host '
+        if host.get('addr6'):
+            command += 'ipv6 '
+        command += host['name']
+        if host.get('udp_port') is not None:
+            command += ' udp-port ' + str(host['udp_port'])
+        return 'no ' + command if remove else command

+        state = item['state']
+        dest = item['dest']
+        desired_facility = item.get('facility')
+        if desired_facility is not None:
+            if state == 'present' and desired_facility != facility:
+                append('logging facility ' + desired_facility)
+                facility = desired_facility
+                facility_explicit = True
+            elif state == 'absent' and facility_explicit and desired_facility == facility:
+                append('no logging facility')
+                facility = 'user'
+                facility_explicit = False
+        if dest == 'host':
+            named_host = search_obj_in_list(item['name'], current_hosts)
+            matching = [h for h in current_hosts if h.get('name') == item['name']
+                        and h.get('addr6') == item['addr6']] if named_host else []
+            if state == 'present':
+                if not any(h.get('udp_port') == item['udp_port'] for h in matching):
+                    for old in matching:
+                        append(host_command(old, remove=True))
+                        current_hosts.remove(old)
+                    append(host_command(item))
+                    current_hosts.append(item.copy())
+            else:
+                for old in matching:
+                    if item['udp_port'] is None or old.get('udp_port') == item['udp_port']:
+                        append(host_command(old, remove=True))
+                        current_hosts.remove(old)
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            levels = item['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, current_levels)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in adds:
+                        append('logging buffered ' + level)
+                current_levels.update(adds)
+            else:
+                removes = current_levels.intersection(levels)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in removes:
+                        append('no logging buffered ' + level)
+                current_levels.difference_update(removes)
+        elif dest in ('on', 'console', 'persistence', 'rfc5424'):
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging ' + dest
+            if state == 'present' and dest not in current_dest:
+                append(command)
+                current_dest.add(dest)
+            elif state == 'absent' and dest in current_dest:
+                append('no ' + command)
+                current_dest.remove(dest)
+    return commands
+

+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS),
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=LEVELS),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'], default='present'),
+    )
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    aggregate_spec['state'].pop('default')
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                                   fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+

+    main()

+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.get_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
+        self.load_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')
+        self.get_config = self.get_patch.start()
+        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
+        self.get_config.return_value = ''
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.get_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_host_and_facility(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514\nlogging facility local3\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=1514),
+                                        dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=514),
+                                        dict(facility='local7')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
+                                                    'logging facility local7'])
+        self.load_config.assert_called_once_with(self.get_config.call_args[0][0],
+                                                  ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
+                                                   'logging facility local7'])
+
+    def test_host_remove_discovers_port_and_ipv6(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514'])
+
+    def test_host_port_change_and_repeat(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=1514))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+                                                    'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 1514'])
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 1514'
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_facility_clear(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging facility local7'
+        set_module_args(dict(facility='local7', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging facility'])
+        self.get_config.return_value = ''
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging facility user'
+        set_module_args(dict(facility='user', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging facility'])
+
+    def test_buffered_levels(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered\nno logging buffered debugging\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging buffered debugging'])
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging buffered debugging'])
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered\nno logging buffered debugging'
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_global_and_console_disable(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging console'
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='console'), dict(dest='on')], state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging console', 'no logging on'])
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'no logging console\nno logging on'
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_rfc5424_persistence_and_check_mode(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='rfc5424'), dict(dest='persistence')],
+                             _ansible_check_mode=True))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging enable rfc5424', 'logging persistence'])
+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_required_parameters(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='host')]))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:broken:address'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+
+    def test_explicit_port_removal_is_exact(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=1514,
+                             state='absent', check_running_config=False))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+        self.assertEqual(self.get_config.call_args[1]['compare'], False)

+        module.fail_json(msg='aggregate must contain at least one logging setting')
+
+    result = []
+    rules = required_if or [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    for entry in entries:
+        item = {key: entry.get(key) if entry.get(key) is not None else params.get(key)
+                for key in ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state')}
+        if item['state'] is None:
+            item['state'] = 'present'
+        if count_terms(item, ('dest', 'facility')) == 0:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest or facility is required')
+        check_required_if(module, rules, item)
+        if item['dest'] != 'host':
+            item['name'] = None
+            item['udp_port'] = None
+        else:
+            item['addr6'] = bool(validate_ip_v6_address(item['name']))
+            if ':' in item['name'] and not item['addr6']:
+                module.fail_json(msg='name must be a valid IPv6 address')
+            if item['udp_port'] is not None:
+                port = int(item['udp_port'])
+                if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
+                    module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be between 1 and 65535')
+                item['udp_port'] = str(port)
+        if item['dest'] == 'buffered':
+            levels = item['level']
+            if not isinstance(levels, (list, tuple, set)):
+                levels = [levels]
+            if not levels or any(level not in LEVELS for level in levels):
+                module.fail_json(msg='level must be a valid buffered logging severity')
+            item['level'] = set(levels)
+        else:
+            item['level'] = None
+        item.setdefault('addr6', False)
+        result.append(item)
+    return result
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    data = get_config(module, flags=['| include logging'],
+                      compare=module.params.get('check_running_config'))
+    obj = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    facility_explicit = False
+    buffered = set()
+    buffered_seen = False
+    logging_on = True
+    for raw in data.splitlines():
+        line = raw.strip()
+        if line == 'no logging on':
+            logging_on = False
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split(None, 2)[2]
+            facility_explicit = True
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+            facility_explicit = False
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered_seen = True
+            buffered = set(LEVELS)
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split(None, 2)[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered_seen = True
+                buffered.add(level)
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split(None, 3)[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered_seen = True
+                buffered.discard(level)
+        elif line == 'no logging buffered':
+            buffered_seen = True
+            buffered.clear()
+        elif line.startswith('logging host '):
+            obj.append(dict(dest='host', name=parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                            udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'),
+                            addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line == 'logging console':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='console'))
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='persistence'))
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='rfc5424'))
+    obj.append(dict(dest='facility', facility=facility, explicit=facility_explicit))
+    if buffered_seen:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='buffered', level=buffered))
+    if logging_on:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='on'))
+    return obj
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    current_facility = next((h for h in have if h.get('dest') == 'facility'), {})
+    facility = current_facility.get('facility', 'user')
+    facility_explicit = current_facility.get('explicit', facility != 'user')
+    current_levels = next((set(h['level']) for h in have if h.get('dest') == 'buffered'), set())
+    current_hosts = [h.copy() for h in have if h.get('dest') == 'host']
+    current_dest = set(h['dest'] for h in have if h.get('dest') not in ('host', 'facility', 'buffered'))
+
+    def append(command):
+        if command not in commands:
+            commands.append(command)
+
+    def host_command(host, remove=False):
+        command = 'logging host '
+        if host.get('addr6'):
+            command += 'ipv6 '
+        command += host['name']
+        if host.get('udp_port') is not None:
+            command += ' udp-port ' + str(host['udp_port'])
+        return 'no ' + command if remove else command
+
+    for item in want:
+        state = item['state']
+        dest = item['dest']
+        desired_facility = item.get('facility')
+        if desired_facility is not None:
+            if state == 'present' and desired_facility != facility:
+                append('logging facility ' + desired_facility)
+                facility = desired_facility
+                facility_explicit = True
+            elif state == 'absent' and facility_explicit and desired_facility == facility:
+                append('no logging facility')
+                facility = 'user'
+                facility_explicit = False
+        if dest == 'host':
+            named_host = search_obj_in_list(item['name'], current_hosts)
+            matching = [h for h in current_hosts if h.get('name') == item['name']
+                        and h.get('addr6') == item['addr6']] if named_host else []
+            if state == 'present':
+                if not any(h.get('udp_port') == item['udp_port'] for h in matching):
+                    for old in matching:
+                        append(host_command(old, remove=True))
+                        current_hosts.remove(old)
+                    append(host_command(item))
+                    current_hosts.append(item.copy())
+            else:
+                for old in matching:
+                    if item['udp_port'] is None or old.get('udp_port') == item['udp_port']:
+                        append(host_command(old, remove=True))
+                        current_hosts.remove(old)
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            levels = item['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, current_levels)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in adds:
+                        append('logging buffered ' + level)
+                current_levels.update(adds)
+            else:
+                removes = current_levels.intersection(levels)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in removes:
+                        append('no logging buffered ' + level)
+                current_levels.difference_update(removes)
+        elif dest in ('on', 'console', 'persistence', 'rfc5424'):
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging ' + dest
+            if state == 'present' and dest not in current_dest:
+                append(command)
+                current_dest.add(dest)
+            elif state == 'absent' and dest in current_dest:
+                append('no ' + command)
+                current_dest.remove(dest)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS),
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=LEVELS),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'], default='present'),
+    )
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    aggregate_spec['state'].pop('default')
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+                         check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                                   fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
